Definition: from G473 and G75; to struggle against (figuratively) ("antagonize"):--strive against.
BiblicalUsage: Hebrews says believers have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin. The word is the struggle itself, a fight carried on against an enemy that will not yield.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for striving against sin carries no doctrine of its own; its challenge is Hebrews', that the fight against sin is a real struggle, not a shrug.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
